The '''Senatorial Palace''' on [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] was the living quarters of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]], situated in an [[Wikipedia:archipelago|archipelago]].

==Characteristics==
The compound had several outlying landing pads, situated right behind the gates of the defensive dome that protected the residence. A detention tower was located next to the main building, where prisoners could be taken and isolated.

Farr had a living room within the residence which displayed the various stuffed animal trophies he had accumulated over his lifetime.

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the senator stayed on Rodia to support his starving people, rather than head back to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. He was visited by his long-time friend, [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] in his residence, and had her taken prisoner in exchange for the services of [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]], who had promised Farr his aid.

During the ensuing rescue mission inside the residence, [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] managed to destroy Gunray's transport and helped capture the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Viceroy/Legends|viceroy]].
